shots.prompt: Slow push-in. A sealed parchment envelope with a gold wax seal materializes from drifting golden light particles on a balcony railing at dusk; Burj Khalifa glowing in the background, warm golden-hour light, cinematic, shallow depth of field.

Medium shot at an abra boat station on Dubai Creek at sunset. The young Chinese woman in a white shirt approaches the elderly South Asian man holding a faded orange hard hat; he looks up and smiles gently. Warm golden light, cinematic, 35mm film look.
Seamless time-lapse transition: the 2026 Dubai skyline at dusk transforms into the futuristic 2049 skyline at night, a new tower rising beside Burj Khalifa, cool blue and gold tones.
